name: NumberStepper
description: A minus/plus number stepper whose digits roll up or down like an odometer on every change, clamps to min/max/step, accelerates while a button is held, and supports arrow, Page and Home/End keys.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA spinbutton pattern: the value display is a focusable role="spinbutton" labelled by the visible label, with aria-valuenow/min/max and aria-valuetext including the suffix. Up/Right and Down/Left step, PageUp/PageDown take larger steps and Home/End jump to min/max. The minus/plus buttons are labelled ('Decrease Guests' / 'Increase Guests'), kept out of the tab order as in the APG example, and disable at the bounds. The rolling digits are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion values change instantly.

propsApi.name: defaultValue
propsApi.description: Initial value when uncontrolled (clamped to min/max).

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the next clamped value.

propsApi.name: step
propsApi.description: Increment per step; its decimal places set the display precision.

propsApi.name: suffix
propsApi.description: Text shown after the number and included in aria-valuetext, e.g. ' kg'.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Button hover/soft tint and focus ring color.

propsApi.name: holdToRepeat
propsApi.description: Keep stepping (and accelerating) while a button is held.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
